crowd: Analysts lean defensive: 1 bullish · 2 neutral · 3 bearish

items.takeaway: The Coinbase premium is at its most negative since the early-July bottom, so US spot buyers are lagging offshore markets.
USDT supply shrank by nearly $1 billion, and if stablecoin supply keeps falling while BTC stalls, the recovery could fade before demand rebuilds.
US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $663M in one day, all into IBIT, wiping out October's net outflows; follow-through is what would confirm demand is back.
Supply in profit slipped back to 53.8% after briefly topping 60%, a normal late-bear 'period of doubt' around the 50% line while confidence rebuilds.
Scoring of FOMC minutes shows the Fed's tone turning more hawkish since March, with most participants expecting another hike before year-end.
After a rejection near $87,000, BTC's MVRV fell back below its 30th percentile, a zone it has spent only about 25% of its time in and consistent with accumulation.
